_note: Demo broadcasts for `pnpm build:demo`. Invented sample stories, not real news. Regenerate the audio with demo/generate.py.

segments.headline: This is a demo broadcast
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Sample stories only  ·  Real channels are scripted hourly from live feeds  ·  Switch channels with the arrow keys
lines: Good evening, and welcome to Pixel Art News. I'm Margot Lane.
And I'm Kofi Mensah. Tonight is a little different: this is a demo, so every story you hear is a sample.
When the channels go live, we'll be reading the real news, summarised from trusted outlets and linked on screen.

segments.headline: Sample story: talks run late into the night
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Sample story  ·  Live stories cite the outlets they come from
lines: In our sample story, negotiators at an imaginary summit have agreed to keep talking past midnight.
And that matters, Margot, because when talks run late it usually means both sides think a deal is close.
We'll bring you any developments, should our imaginary negotiators make any.

segments.headline: Coming up on World
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Coming up: more sample headlines
lines: Coming up after the break: a round-up of the day's other sample headlines.
Stay with us. This is Pixel Art News.

segments.headline: Tech desk: demo edition
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Sample stories only  ·  Ray Byte, live from the server room
lines: Hey, welcome to the tech desk. I'm Ray Byte, coming to you from inside a very warm server rack.
Quick heads up: this is a demo, so tonight's gadgets are entirely made up. The real ones arrive when the feeds switch on.

segments.headline: Sample story: a phone battery that lasts a week
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Sample story  ·  Battery claims, tested later
lines: Our sample story: a new chip that promises a phone battery lasting a whole week.
Now, I love a big claim as much as anyone. But week-long battery life usually means very dim screens, or very optimistic testing.
So: interesting, possibly true, and definitely worth waiting for the independent reviews.

segments.headline: Next: Gadget Check
lines: Next up, it's Gadget Check, where I plug things in so you don't have to. Don't go anywhere.

segments.headline: Lab Notes: demo edition
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Sample stories only  ·  Lab Notes with Professor Ada Quark
lines: Good evening, and welcome to Lab Notes. I'm Professor Ada Quark.
Tonight's experiments are purely hypothetical, because this is a demo. Real discoveries will follow once our feeds are switched on.

segments.headline: Sample story: water vapour spotted on a distant moon
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Sample story  ·  Preliminary results, as always
lines: In our sample story, a telescope has spotted what looks like water vapour drifting above a distant moon.
Think of it like seeing breath on a cold morning: it doesn't tell you there's a person, but it tells you something is going on.
As always, these results would be preliminary until other teams can check them.

segments.headline: Coming up on Science
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Coming up: more sample science
lines: After the break: why your kettle is secretly a lesson in thermodynamics. Do stay tuned.

segments.headline: The round-up: demo edition
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Sample results only  ·  Gus and Dee in the studio
lines: Evening, everyone. I'm Gus Ginger, and with me as always is Dee Striker.
Evening, Gus! Now, I have to tell everyone: this is a demo, so tonight's results are completely invented.
Which means for once, Dee, your predictions can't be wrong.

segments.headline: Sample story: late winner sends the underdogs through
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Sample story  ·  Final score, also imaginary
lines: Our sample story: the underdogs have reached the final with a winner in the last minute.
And tactically, Gus, that's all about fresh legs. Bring a striker on late against tired defenders and things open right up.
Fresh legs. I've been saying that about my own for years.

segments.headline: Coming up on Sport
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Coming up: the results round-up
lines: Coming up, the full results round-up, with every sample score.

segments.headline: Weird News: demo edition
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Sample stories only  ·  Rex Fizz and Zorp, unexplained
lines: Welcome, welcome, welcome to Weird News! I'm Rex Fizz!
I am Zorp. I have been told this is a demo. On my planet, all news is a demo.
Tonight's stories are samples, folks, but trust me, the real ones are even stranger!

segments.headline: Sample story: town elects a goat as honorary mayor
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Sample story  ·  The goat has not commented
lines: Our sample scoop of the century: a small town has elected a goat as its honorary mayor!
I have studied your elections. This seems like an improvement.
Zorp! We do not endorse goats!
Noted. I will endorse them privately.

segments.headline: Next: the Odd Spot
lines: Coming up in the Odd Spot: a potato that looks exactly like a famous lighthouse!
I have seen it. It is a potato.
